children.value: and the half squared error is

import numpy as np

x = np.array([1, 0, 1])
y = 1

# columns = hidden neurons, rows = inputs
W1 = np.array([[0.2, -0.3],
               [0.4,  0.1],
               [-0.5, 0.2]])
b1 = np.array([-0.4, 0.2])
W2 = np.array([-0.3, -0.2])
b2 = 0.1

def relu(z):
    return np.maximum(0, z)

z_hidden = x @ W1 + b1
h = relu(z_hidden)
z_out = h @ W2 + b2
y_hat = relu(z_out)
error = y_hat - y

print("Hidden Z :", z_hidden)
print("Hidden H :", h)
print("Output Z :", round(z_out, 4))
print("y_hat    :", round(y_hat, 4))
print("Error    :", round(error, 4))
print("Squared  :", round(error ** 2, 4))
